briefs.rationale: Hodge theory is carried from compact surfaces to compact Kähler manifolds: Hodge decomposition via elliptic harmonic forms, the Hermitian exterior Lefschetz decomposition with its Weil-star identity, and, through the rational Kähler polarization of smooth projective varieties, the Kähler identities giving the Lefschetz sl2 and hard Lefschetz, together with polarizable rational Hodge structures, their orthogonal semisimple substructures and the Hodge–Riemann bilinear relations. The established arc (contour–Cauchy–residue calculus; Poisson–Dirichlet–Green–capacity; Fatou–Blaschke Hardy spaces; Bergman–Szegő kernels; Hartogs–pseudoconvexity–Hörmander; Runge–Mittag-Leffler–Weierstrass–Gamma; Poisson–Jensen and Nevanlinna; Montel–Schwarz–Pick–Bloch–Schottky–Picard, Riemann mapping, extremal length, quasiconformality, Beltrami and measurable Riemann mapping, welding and removability; monodromy and uniformization; elliptic and modular functions; zeta) is condensed thematically to keep the brief within the 120-word budget. The frontmatter is the block-style pages list that the sync extended correctly, so no mechanical repair was needed.

Compact elliptic analysis enters the smooth-manifold arc: second-order Laplace-type operators on Hermitian vector bundles with positive principal symbol admit formal adjoints, parametrices and elliptic regularity, and compact Sobolev embedding with a shifted coercive variational problem gives the exact H^2 domain, a finite smooth kernel and a smooth Green inverse, hence harmonic representatives for de Rham and Dolbeault cohomology. The rewrite also names Jacobi fields and Gauss–Bonnet alongside the existing manifold/bundle/flow, Stokes–de Rham, metric–connection–geodesic–curvature–comparison, symplectic and characteristic-form material and the Lie-theory separation. The three gained pages open the geometric track: equivariant constructible perverse foundations (simplicial action nerve, Cartesian-cohomology constructible complexes, conservative restriction, finite resolution-triple comparison, coinduced injective models from locally split Cech descent); quiver full-flag projective semisimplicity (stable-flag incidence as a subbundle over the representation space, projective projection, explicit smooth projective compactifications); and the signed KLR realization (normalized pi_!-complexes and fiber-product correspondence convolution, relative-position strata and Chern classes generating the relations, so the signed KLR algebra is an equivariant Ext algebra over every characteristic-zero field). The finite-group/modular and unitary analytic halves are kept, with Reiter–Følner and spectral-gap detail condensed to hold the brief at 119 words. Mechanical repair: the three synced page lines were moved from after the '- part:' line into the part's pages list, restoring the stable slug representation-theory and the page order.

The part now spans the Hecke–KLR–crystal arc, so the brief is rewritten as a thematic ladder: rim hooks and Murnaghan–Nakayama; cellular and signed Murphy comparisons; cores, abacus calculus and blocks; modular branching and the good-node crystal; Soergel intersection forms and Hodge theory, projective functors, parabolic and singular Kazhdan–Lusztig theory and the character/multiplicity theorem; parabolic category O with Fock bases and Ringel duality; Arakawa–Suzuki functors and higher-level Schur–Weyl duality; cyclotomic Hecke and quiver Hecke algebras, cyclotomic KLR highest-weight categorification, KLR PBW and quantum-Serre categorification; Ariki and degenerate Ariki categorification with graded decomposition numbers; quantum affine level-one Fock space and the residue-crystal bridge; divided powers, quantum highest weights, Kashiwara operators, crystal lattices, balanced triples, global and tensor-product bases; Kronecker coefficients, FI-modules and Murnaghan stability; and the geometric interface (equivariant Borel–Moore convolution, constructible Ext, proper cohomological descent and hypercovers). Every gained page is represented by one of these roles, and the brief stays inside the 120-word budget.
